title: A trace result follows from its normalized presentation
statement: For l prime, Noetherian schemes X,S with diagonal localizations, f:X→S and a specified projective-line model e with e.hom≫q=f, with l invertible on S, there is Result t over ULift(Q_l) whose model is exactly e. This is the trace existence part only, without any supported diagonal source or integration identity.

source.place: paragraph (1), lifting the system trace and checking finite reductions

proof.text: Obtain the normalized presentation. The exact restriction maps its biproduct splitting to the restricted biproduct splitting through the canonical inverse biproduct comparison, so strict_split is invertible.

Lift sourceMap≫Rlim(systemTrace)≫unitMap inverse by surjectivity of the specified Hom map. Cancellation of unitMap proves IsTrace. Naturality of each Rlim projection gives reductions. Retain the finite unit and Chern identities and the prescribed model.

theorem exists_diagonalTraceResult
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S)
    (he : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) :
    ∃ t : Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f, t.model.model = e
